## DirectSignal type

A direct signal sent by a remote agent. Holochain treats the payload as opaque bytes; the application decides how to decode it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type DirectSignal = {
    cell_id: CellId;
    from_agent: AgentPubKey;
    signal: Uint8Array;
};
```
